::: {.section-intro}
GLBFP provides ASH, LBFP and General Linear Blend Frequency Polygon density estimators. It supports pointwise and grid-based estimation, plotting and bandwidth selection.
:::

CRAN version: 0.5.2. GitHub development version: 0.5.2.9000.

::: {.link-list}
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=GLBFP){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
[GitHub](https://github.com/AurelienNicosiaULaval/GLBFP){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
[Documentation](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/GLBFP/){.btn .btn-outline-dark}
:::

## Distinct release capabilities

The CRAN release provides the density estimators. The development version adds `compute_Di()`, a leave-one-out diagnostic with a fixed grid and bandwidth. This function is not included in GLBFP 0.5.2 on CRAN.

The preprint by Nicosia, Duchesne and Carbon (2026), [A Leave-One-Out Influence Statistic for Density-Based Outlier Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14335), studies the single-grid LBFP case. The repository separately documents the software extensions to ASH and GLBFP.

## Getting started

The [documentation](https://aureliennicosiaulaval.github.io/GLBFP/) covers installation, estimators, examples and the diagnostics available in each version.
